a literal the loop builds at entry. It is the call made just before the thread sleeps, in the TXSTAT read at 0x80009c1c. Not an alias of seg0 0x10009c14, which is unrelated code
the loop's kick-state struct pointer (GbP+92), a data address. It sits inside a stub only if read as a PC

0x80009c74 (run 57 hot spot) is inside the loop, on the path after a timer wake. 0x10022940/0x1002291c/0x100228b0/0x100228d0 are inside seg0's code range. Requests 16 and 20 called these 'outside the text' because they ignored the 2:1 mapping; that was wrong
request 17's halted PC decodes UNKNOWN (one of the ~2% of lines minim.py cannot expand), so it stays undecided

the firmware reaches RGX at META 0x02000000: the thread entry (0x100009ac) passes 0x02000000 to the init copy (0x10003c80), which stores it in GbP+36. Every RGX access goes through it. Its 0xb30 = 0xffdf and 0xb40 = 0xffff writes match run 70's reads. This corrects the 'RGX at fwaddr 0' guess

GbP+28 is the root (rings: TA +0x0/+0x4, 3D +0x8/+0xc, CL +0x10/+0x14, DC +0x18/+0x1c). Root +0x454 points at the config block: the init copy moves config +0x250, +0x258, +0x254, +0x26c, ... into priv +0x228, +0x22c, +0x230, +0x234, ... (out of order, as Orchard found on the A9)
